tested_scope: Evidence audit only for the AblateCell system-level reproduce-then-ablate claim as represented by scientist_agents candidate_095. This slice does not execute AblateCell, CPA, GEARS, or BioLORD; it does not generalize beyond the three reported single-cell perturbation repositories and does not treat system-level AblateCell performance as a matched causal ablation of the reproduce-first gate itself.

provenance.paper: AblateCell: A Reproduce-then-Ablate Agent for Virtual Cell Repositories

paper_claim.exact_scope: CPA, GEARS, and BioLORD single-cell perturbation repositories
paper_claim.mechanism_description: The paper describes establishing a verified baseline by auto-configuring environments, resolving dependency/data issues, rerunning official training/inference, and emitting reproducible artifacts before graph-based isolated ablations with adaptive sampling.
paper_claim.causal_scope_guard: These system-level results support the reproduce-then-ablate workflow but do not isolate the marginal causal contribution of the reproduce-first gate from planner/executor, domain-knowledge, adaptive-sampling, or worktree-isolation components.

observations: The arXiv primary record and HTML paper describe verifiable/reproducible artifacts and official training/inference reruns.

The arXiv record exposes paper/HTML/TeX and generic code-discovery integrations, but the bounded inspection did not surface a direct first-party AblateCell GitHub repository or commit-pinned executable release.
A bounded GitHub-domain web search for AblateCell did not return a first-party code repository.
official_artifact_support.interpretation: Do not upgrade the paper's reported reproduction TSR into externally reproducible artifact support until a first-party executable artifact, immutable revision, environment specification, and reproduction entry point are located and read back.

independent_replication.search_scope: Exact-title/name web search for independent replication/reproduction plus GitHub-domain code search on 2026-09-06.
independent_replication.scope_guard: Absence in this bounded search is not evidence that no independent replication exists; it only means no independent execution report was verified in this slice.

failed_replication.scope_guard: No failure claim is inferred from missing public replication evidence.

missing_or_unverified: first-party AblateCell executable repository or release
immutable code revision/commit for the evaluated AblateCell system
complete environment/container specification tied to that revision
public reproduction entry point and artifact manifest sufficient to rerun the reported three-repository evaluation
missing_dependencies_config.note: The paper describes containerized/reproducible execution, but this audit does not equate a methodological description with a verified runnable artifact.

audit_result.allowed_downstream_use: Use as primary-paper support for a reproduce-before-ablate attribution workflow with exact three-repository scope. Do not label it independently replicated, artifact-verified, or a matched ablation proving the reproduce-first gate alone caused the reported gain.

evidence.supports: system description; CPA/GEARS/BioLORD evaluation; 96.3% reproduction TSR; 92.0% ablation TSR; 88.9% end-to-end TSR; 93.3% critical-component accuracy

evidence.query_scope: AblateCell GitHub code repository, github.com domain

evidence.result: no independent execution/replication report verified; only mirrors, summaries, and bibliographic records surfaced

continuation: On the next reproducibility_auditor invocation, re-bootstrap from current controls, then stay on candidate_095 and locate/read back a first-party AblateCell executable artifact or immutable repository revision if one is publicly exposed; verify environment/reproduction entry points and artifact manifest without running paid/finite-quota compute. If no first-party artifact is exposed, perform one bounded search for an independent execution report tied to an exact code revision and exact CPA/GEARS/BioLORD tested scope. Preserve provisional_primary_only until direct artifact or independent execution evidence exists.
